identity_check: Confirmed as Forgepoint Inc. (forgepoint.ai), the US start-up behind 'Frank', an AI inside sales rep that runs the RFQ-to-quote workflow for manufacturers. The company site (home, company, product, careers and press pages), the a16z speedrun company page, and SiliconANGLE, TechFundingNews, The Next Web and American Bazaar coverage of 2026-10-14 all describe the same product, the same co-founders (Jack Strauss, CEO; Alex Pareto, CTO) and the same $9.8M seed co-led by Primary Venture Partners and a16z speedrun; the company's press page links to the funding coverage. Not any other business using the Forgepoint name (e.g. investment firms); no page read links them. Not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; found through a discovery search. Category set to direct: Frank reads customer RFQs including PDFs and CAD files, extracts materials, dimensions and tolerances, drafts a BOM, prices each line against the shop's cost model and sends and follows up the quote, which is Utopian Autonomy's RFQ / BOM / engineering-drawing wedge. Differences: it is a sell-side tool for sales reps and estimators at US job shops (foundries, fabricators, molders, machine shops), working over email, text and chat on top of the ERP; no procurement, maintenance or process-stability agents and no WhatsApp channel were seen.

company.name: Forgepoint
company.description: US start-up selling 'Frank', an AI inside sales rep that turns manufacturers' incoming RFQs (emails, PDFs, CAD) into priced quotes and follows them up.

layer_detail: Sell-side quoting / estimating for job shops rather than the plant floor: Frank qualifies inbound RFQs (email, PDF, spreadsheet, CAD), extracts materials, dimensions, tolerances, quantities and due dates from drawings, chases missing specs, drafts a BOM and prices each line against the shop's cost model, routes the quote for human sign-off, sends it, tracks opens and runs follow-ups, and logs everything to the account and job. Integrates with ERPs (Epicor, NetSuite, SAP, Sage, Infor, Syspro, Acumatica, Dynamics 365 Business Central). Industries listed: injection molding, steel mills, foundries, metal service centers, fabricators, stampers, coating and heat treat, CNC machining, forging, fasteners. process_planning is the nearest layer (drawing-to-quote), as for IndustrialMind's quoting agent.
product_summary: Frank, an AI inside sales rep for manufacturers: reads incoming RFQs and drawings, asks buyers for missing details, drafts a BOM and prices it with the shop's own cost rules, holds the quote for human approval, then sends it, tracks buyer engagement and follows up, logging activity into the ERP / CRM.
